title: The Colorful Future of LLMs: Evaluating and Improving LLMs as Emotional Supporters for Queer Youth

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to real Reddit posts from queer youth using a novel 10-question psychological scale that measures LGBTQ+ inclusiveness, emotional validation, and sensitivity through both human and automatic (LLM-as-a-judge) annotations.

Qualitatively evaluating LLM responses to case studies featuring queer youth from non-Western or conservative religious backgrounds (e.g., Afghanistan, ultra-orthodox Jewish) to identify cultural ignorance, Western-centric assumptions, and potentially harmful advice.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
